test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year was the Multi-dimensional Poverty Index launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) was **launched in India in 2021** to measure poverty in a holistic way beyond income-based assessments.
 
• The MPI considers multiple deprivations at the household level in education, health, and living standards.
 
• It is developed by the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)** and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• The Indian version of MPI is aligned with the global MPI methodology but tailored to India's socio-economic context.
 
• The launch of MPI in 2021 was part of India's efforts to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 1: No Poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI):**

 
 
• The MPI identifies multiple deprivations at the household and individual level in health, education, and standard of living.
 
• It uses 10 indicators to measure poverty in three dimensions: education, health, and living standards.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The SDGs are a collection of 17 global goals set by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015 for the year 2030.
 
• They cover a broad range of social, economic, and environmental development issues.
 
 
 
• **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI):**
 
 
• OPHI is a research center within the Oxford Department of International Development at the University of Oxford.
 
• It aims to build and advance a more systematic methodological and economic framework for reducing multidimensional poverty.
 
 
 
• **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP):**
 
 
• UNDP works in nearly 170 countries and territories, helping to achieve the eradication of poverty, and the reduction of inequalities and exclusion.
 
• It helps countries to develop policies, leadership skills, partnering abilities, and institutional capabilities.
